Entrezgene.Entrezgene_summary: Predicted to enable fibroblast growth factor receptor binding activity and growth factor activity. Acts upstream of or within anatomical structure homeostasis; fin regeneration; and regulation of bone remodeling. Predicted to be active in cytoplasm and extracellular region. Is expressed in caudal fin; dermatocranium; inter-frontal joint; and kidney. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in renal agenesis. Orthologous to human FGF20 (fibroblast growth factor 20). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

Gene-commentary.Gene-commentary_text: The evidence presented here indicates that fgf20a is important for normal mid-facial and calvarial growth and homeostasis in zebrafish, and that a key aspect of its influence on skull morphogenesis is the regulation of osteoblast and osteoclast activity during craniofacial remodeling.
Data indicate that fgf20a, fgf24, FGF receptor fgfr1 are expressed in normal and regenerating barbel tissue.
Hdac1 is required for expression of erm and fgf20a in rhombomeres; Hdac1-dependent expression of these two genes is attenuated in rhombomere boundary regions by Notch signalling activity
fgf20a is expressed in the intact fin and is required for homeostasis.
fgf20a has a regeneration-specific requirement, initiating fin regeneration, and controlling blastema formation
